build: Release -O3 -DNDEBUG, static libraries, generic FAISS kernels
method: 100 single-query timings after 16 warmup queries, normal synthetic vectors, exact top-k ground truth. Engine execution order alternates per query. Each case rebuilds both indexes. No concurrent local build jobs during final query measurements.
comparison: Native is ordinary FAISS IndexHNSWFlat with same M, efConstruction, efSearch, seed, metric, data. ACORN and exact are distinct algorithms; equal ef is not a matched-recall guarantee. ACORN uses 10 deterministic predicate-matching seeds.
limits: Warm memory/cache, one process, one pass per case, 100 queries. No cold-cache, concurrent-writer, crash-recovery, production-data or million-vector qualification. Native retains tombstones via query selector for churn runs.
